members.name: selected
members.doc: Whether the ToggleButton is on, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultSelected
members.doc: Whether the ToggleButton starts on, when it controls itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the ToggleButton: it can be neither focused nor toggled.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. Without one, a ToggleButton in a ToggleButtonGroup takes the group's size, and any other takes md.

members.name: variant
members.doc:
How the selected state is drawn. default fills a selected ToggleButton. quiet draws no outline and no selected fill,
for a toggle repeated down a list: its text turns from muted to strong, and the caller changes the glyph or label
with the state. quiet is not available inside a ToggleButtonGroup, which draws its own selected fill.

members.name: preventFocusOnPress
members.doc:
Keeps focus where it is when a pointer presses the ToggleButton, such as a formatting tool that must leave the text
selection in an editor. The keyboard still focuses and activates it.

members.name: onActivate
members.doc: Reports an activation of the ToggleButton.

types.name: ToggleButtonActivationEvent
